packageRules.description: splunk-packaging-toolkit (slim) passes on Python 3.13 and fails on 3.15 with "No module named imp". Hold the workflow Python on 3.13 until packaging moves off slim.

ksconf 0.13.10, the newest release, reads splunklib.__version__, which splunk-sdk 3 no longer sets, so ksconf diff and filter fail on splunk-sdk 3. Hold splunk-sdk on 2.x until a ksconf release supports 3.
